what: Several full-screen images (video) stay pinned to the screen and switch every screenful of scroll like flipping TV channels — the outgoing image slides 14px left and tilts 6° over .14s power3.in while fading, and the incoming image settles from 16px right·−5°·1.08x·2px blur over .38s power4.out. During those .38s gray noise (red·blue misaligned) and five torn bands cover it, and a white flash (.45, .05s round trip) hits. Before the switch (progress .88~1) scanlines slowly darken, and while an image dwells it slowly drifts to −28px·1.05x. Scroll snaps to the nearest image (.16~.38s power3.inOut). When the image changes, fx:zap(detail.index) fires
ease: Enter power4.out · exit power3.in · stick power3.inOut

options.dur: Turn duration (s), default 0.38 — noise uses the same duration
options.pre: Progress at which the scanline preview begins, default .88
options.drift: Distance (px) the image shifts while dwelling, default -28
options.snap: If ”false”, it won’t snap to the nearest Section
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: One slide (at least two required) — the first child inside (the panel wrapping the image or video) moves
options.fx:zap: Events fired from an element when sections change (bubbles) — detail.index · detail.prev

from.where: visuals.html .vs__list (video collection — eight-section channel flipping, name letter shuffle and live card attach at the fx:zap spot)

note: Sections stand at screen height (100vh) and are pinned for sections − 1 screens. The noise panel is drawn at .62x the screen (480×270 to 854×480) and stretched
